name: Pádraic Conroy
source:
A calm, nondescript presence lurking in the background of any meeting involving both the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Anarch]Anarchs[/url] and [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Camarilla[/url], Pádraic Conroy easily assumes his mantle of a mediator. Although disdained for his [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Caitiff]Caitiff[/url] provenience by the Ivory Tower figures, he not only continuously serves his purpose as the peacemaker, but also acts as an advisor to [url=/c166401]Torque[/url], the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Baron_(VTM)]Baron[/url] of the Bronx.

Uptight, taciturn, and surrounded by the air of mystery, Pádraic is tasked with shadowing [url=/c142690]Kali[/url] in her search for her missing [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Sire]sire[/url], all the while skirting around his most private affairs.

[Spoiler]Pádraic harbors a secret: he is, in fact, a [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Malkavian_(VTM)]Malkavian[/url], hiding his identity from the world to divert attention from the unique Voice that plagues his mind. He finds it easier to endure the scorn as a Caitiff than to navigate through the barrage of questions that would surely arise should his provenience come to light.[/spoiler]

[From the in-game profile]
